title: GorillaDesk vs Jobber (2026): Pricing & Pest Features
description: GorillaDesk vs Jobber: per-route vs per-user pricing, cost for 1-7 person teams, chemical tracking, routing, QuickBooks and trials. Checked Nov 2, 2026.
h1: GorillaDesk vs Jobber for pest control and route businesses
body:
GorillaDesk and Jobber come up together whenever a pest control, pool or lawn route business shops for software. They charge in different ways: GorillaDesk charges per route (technician schedule) and gives you unlimited users, while Jobber charges per user in team-size tiers. Every number below comes from each vendor's own pricing page, checked on 2026-11-02 (GorillaDesk, Jobber). If a vendor doesn't publish something, we mark it unknown.

{{table:gorilladesk,jobber}}

Pricing models: per route vs per user

  • GorillaDesk: Basic $49/mo, Pro $99/mo, Growth $149/mo for your first route, billed monthly. Extra routes on Basic cost +$50/mo each for routes 2-3 and +$30/mo each from route 4. On Pro they're +$50/mo each. On Growth, route 2 is +$100/mo and routes 3 and up are +$50/mo each. Admin, office and crew users are unlimited and free. Only techs with their own schedule count, and crews that ride together share one route. GorillaDesk also sells an annual plan billed up front, but it doesn't publish that price (unknown).
  • Jobber: Core $29/mo billed annually ($39/mo with a 1-year commitment, $49/mo with no commitment) for 1 user. Connect is $99/$119/$139 and Grow $149/$169/$199 for 1 user (annual / 1-year monthly / no commitment). Plus is $399/$439/$499 and includes 5 users. Connect and Grow also come in 5-, 10- and 15-user tiers, and extra users are $29/mo each.

What the same team costs on each

We worked these out from the list prices above (USD per month, before tax and payment fees). GorillaDesk prices are monthly because its annual price isn't published. For Jobber we show both the annual and no-commitment prices, using the cheapest published way to reach the head count (a user tier plus $29/mo per extra user).

TeamGorillaDesk (monthly)Jobber (billed annually / no commitment)
Solo operator, 1 route, 1 userBasic $49; Pro $99Core $29 / $49; Connect $99 / $139
3 solo techs + 1 office user (3 routes, 4 users)Basic $149; Pro $199; Growth $299Connect 5-user $149 / $199; Grow 5-user $229 / $299
5 solo techs + 1 office user (5 routes, 6 users)Basic $209; Pro $299; Growth $399Connect $178 / $228; Grow $258 / $328 (5-user tier + 1 extra user at $29)
2 crews of 3 riding together + 1 office user (2 routes, 7 users)Basic $99; Pro $149; Growth $249Connect $207 / $257; Grow $287 / $357 (5-user tier + 2 extra users at $29)

The pattern: GorillaDesk costs less when several people share each route, because users are free. Jobber's annual tiers can cost less when every tech runs their own route and you prepay for the year. For one solo operator, Jobber Core billed annually ($29/mo) has the lowest published entry price, but Core doesn't include QuickBooks sync or routing. More detail: GorillaDesk pricing by route and Jobber pricing by plan.

Pest and chemical records

GorillaDesk includes material tracking and reporting for chemical use records on Basic, and device tracking and barcoding for traps and equipment (with trend reporting) on Pro. Jobber's pricing page doesn't list chemical or material-use tracking or device barcoding, so for Jobber those are unknown. Jobber does list custom checklists from Connect, plus expense tracking and job costing on its higher plans. If you have to keep pesticide application records, ask Jobber directly before you choose it. See our best pest control software guide for more pest-specific options.

Routing and scheduling

GorillaDesk Basic includes basic routing capped at 25 stops. Pro adds Drive Matrix routing (real-time street routing and drive times) and GPS device tracking, and Growth adds drive-time display, "Best Available Time" and "Job Magnet" scheduling tools. Jobber includes routing (route optimization) and GPS tracking from Connect, but not on Core. It also lists "Find a Time" smart scheduling and crew scheduling (Plus) in its feature table.

Booking, texting and QuickBooks

  • Online booking: GorillaDesk Pro and up. Jobber lists online booking among Core's key features.
  • Texting: GorillaDesk includes automated email and SMS reminders from Basic, but texting needs a $5/mo SMS subscription plus credit packs ($50 for 1,000, $100 for 2,500 or $200 for 8,000 messages, and credits never expire). Jobber includes automated client reminders on Connect and two-way text messaging on Grow. We couldn't find any extra Jobber texting fee on its pricing page.
  • QuickBooks: GorillaDesk syncs with QuickBooks Online on Pro and up. Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect and up.

Payments

Jobber processes cards itself: 2.9% + 30¢ online, 2.7% + 30¢ with Tap to Pay, 1% for ACH bank payments, and +1% for instant payouts. GorillaDesk connects to Stripe and Square, so you pay their processing rates. Stripe or Square subscriptions for automated recurring billing come with GorillaDesk Pro.

Trials and contracts

Both offer a 14-day free trial with no credit card. GorillaDesk's trial covers its plans (it suggests starting on Growth), and Jobber's trial runs on Grow. GorillaDesk is month-to-month, with no contracts or setup fees, free data migration, and an account freeze for seasonal businesses. Jobber offers no-commitment monthly billing, monthly billing with a 1-year commitment, or annual prepaid billing, and the annual prepayment is non-refundable.

Which should you pick?

  • Pest control route business that needs chemical records: GorillaDesk, because material tracking is on its $49/mo Basic plan and device barcoding is on Pro. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk plans}}
  • Crews that ride together, or lots of office staff: GorillaDesk, because users are free and you pay only per route.
  • Solo operator on the lowest budget, or mixed one-off and recurring jobs: Jobber Core at $29/mo billed annually. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}
  • Every tech on their own route, and you're fine prepaying for a year: compare Jobber's 5- and 10-user annual tiers with GorillaDesk's per-route total in the table above.

faq: It depends on team shape. For one solo user, Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment) and GorillaDesk Basic is $49/mo. For 2 crews of 3 sharing 2 routes, GorillaDesk Pro is $149/mo, while Jobber Connect for 7 users is $207/mo billed annually (5-user tier $149 + 2 extra users at $29). Prices checked 2026-11-02.
No. GorillaDesk charges per route (technician schedule) and includes unlimited admin, manager, sales and crew users on every plan. Jobber charges per user, with extra users at $29/mo each.
Does Jobber track pesticide or chemical use?
Jobber's pricing page doesn't list chemical or material-use tracking, so we mark it unknown. GorillaDesk lists material tracking and reporting for chemical use records on its Basic plan.
Do GorillaDesk and Jobber have free trials?
Yes. Both list a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. Jobber's trial runs on its Grow plan.
Do GorillaDesk and Jobber sync with QuickBooks?
Yes. GorillaDesk syncs with QuickBooks Online on Pro ($99/mo first route) and up. Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect ($99/mo billed annually) and up.
Is there a contract with GorillaDesk or Jobber?

GorillaDesk is month-to-month with no contracts or setup fees, and you can freeze your account seasonally. Jobber offers no-commitment monthly billing, a 1-year commitment billed monthly, or annual prepaid billing (non-refundable).
